questions.category: B1 - Use Construction Drawings and Specifications
questions.question: On a roof framing plan, what information is most important for laying out rafters or trusses?
options: Span, spacing, roof slope, and bearing points
questions.explanation: Roof framing layout depends on span, spacing, slope, and supports. These details control member placement and load transfer. Finish information does not replace structural layout requirements.

questions.category: B2 - Interpret Building Codes and Bylaws
questions.question: Why do building codes set minimum stair dimensions?
options: To reduce fall hazards and improve safe movement
To make stairs harder to build
questions.explanation: Stairs are a common fall-risk area. Code requirements for rise, run, landings, guards, and handrails improve safety. Comfort alone is not enough if code is not met.

questions.question: Before changing the blade on a cordless circular saw, what should you do?
options: Place the saw on your knee
questions.explanation: Removing the battery prevents accidental startup. Blade changes must be done with the tool de-energized. This is a basic portable power tool safety step.

questions.question: When ripping narrow stock on a table saw, which device helps keep hands away from the blade?
questions.explanation: A push stick controls narrow stock while keeping hands away. It is essential when the fence and blade are close. It reduces the chance of blade contact.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of batter boards?
options: Hold layout strings outside the excavation area
questions.explanation: Batter boards hold string lines for building layout. They are placed outside excavation so layout can be restored. They help maintain accurate corners and lines.
